title: Youth groups seek TRO vs postponement of barangay, SK polls
summary: Youth groups asked the Supreme Court on Monday to issue a Temporary Restraining Order (TRO) against the postponement of the 2026 Barangay and Sangguniang Kabataan Elections (BSKE).
